text_markup: A player's {term:score area} is the zone in which they place agendas they have scored or stolen. {ref:Sec_score_scoring_steal} details scoring and stealing agendas. Score areas start the game empty.
text_plain: A player's score area is the zone in which they place agendas they have scored or stolen. Section 1.17 details scoring and stealing agendas. Score areas start the game empty.
